claim_map.title: Producer-specific validation and completeness
claim_map.text: For SCBML, hide cashflows from Settlement Ops while incomplete or pending trade validation. If cashflow trade state is unvalidated, inspect parent trade validation. Hold an unvalidated parent and resume affected cashflows from the TDS3 validation update. Uber checks for an existing group; create one only when absent. Offset matching cashflows, otherwise save messages pending. Uber resolves pending trade validation through the validated Uber version without a query. These are separate producer paths.
claim_map.confidence: high for bounded source-specific wording; current applicability unresolved
claim_map.rationale: Selected original text explicitly supplies this rule or labelled proposal; competing scope and omissions remain stated.

claim_map.title: Group ordering and search identity
claim_map.text: A declared cashflow count gates normal group processing until all expected messages arrive. Even a complete batch can remain pending_pre_group until previous groups consume necessary messages. The page mentions manual delivery without defining grants or recovery. FMRP uses trade ID for all-version Group Blotter searches. Murex uses original trade ID and maps upstream flow ID to its RATAN cashflow identity. Examples are explanatory, without executed completeness or identity assertions.
claim_map.confidence: high for bounded source-specific wording; current applicability unresolved
claim_map.rationale: Selected original text explicitly supplies this rule or labelled proposal; competing scope and omissions remain stated.
